name: Quality Meeting-custom_minutes_guidance
label: How to Record Minutes
options:
How to record minutes. One row per discussion item or decision, linked to the record it concerns:
  • Quality Review — discussing results against a Quality Goal (we measured). Write the conclusion the meeting drew from the review.
  • Quality Action — the meeting decides to correct or prevent something (we are fixing). Raise the Quality Action first, link it here, and write the decision with owner and target date.
  • Quality Feedback — discussing what a customer or employee reported (we were told). Write what was noted and any follow-up agreed.
A management review normally reads reviews and feedback and produces actions. Assign a ToDo for every action item so follow-up is tracked to the next meeting. This record is the filled FRM-024; REG-019 registers it automatically.
